sentences.text: Aubrey Drake Graham -LRB- born October 24 , 1986 -RRB- better known by the stage name Drake , is a Canadian rapper , singer , songwriter , record producer , and actor .	producer	Hip hop production
Drake initially gained recognition as an actor on the teen drama television series Degrassi : The Next Generation in the early 2000s .	teen drama	teen drama
Intent on pursuing a career as a rapper , he departed the series in 2007 following the release of his debut mixtape , Room for Improvement .	Room for Improvement	Room for Improvement (mixtape)

He released two further independent projects , Comeback Season and So Far Gone , before signing to Lil Wayne 's Young Money Entertainment in June 2009 .	Young Money	Young Money Entertainment	Lil Wayne	Lil Wayne	Comeback Season	Comeback Season (mixtape)	So Far Gone	So Far Gone (mixtape)	Young Money Entertainment	Young Money Entertainment

Drake released his debut studio album Thank Me Later in 2010 , which debuted at number one on the U.S. Billboard 200 and was soon certified platinum by the Recording Industry Association of America -LRB- RIAA -RRB- .	Thank Me Later	Thank Me Later	platinum	Music recording sales certification	Recording Industry Association of America	Recording Industry Association of America

His next two releases were 2011 's Take Care and 2013 's Nothing Was the Same , with certifications of quadruple and triple platinum respectively in the U.S. , with the former also earning him his first Grammy Award for Best Rap Album .	platinum	Music recording sales certification	Take Care	Take Care (album)	Nothing Was the Same	Nothing Was the Same	Grammy Award	Grammy Award	Best Rap Album	Grammy Award for Best Rap Album

They were followed by two mixtapes , with the trap-influenced If You 're Reading This It 's Too Late , and a collaboration with Future for What a Time to Be Alive , in 2015 , which both also earned platinum certification in the U.S.	Future	Future (rapper)	platinum	Music recording sales certification	trap	trap music	What a Time to Be Alive	What a Time to Be Alive
Drake released his fourth album , Views , in 2016 , breaking several chart records in the process .	Views	Views (album)
The dancehall-influenced album sat atop the Billboard 200 for ten nonconsecutive weeks , becoming the first album by a solo male to do so in over 10 years .	dancehall	dancehall
Its single `` One Dance '' topped the chart in several countries , including the U.S. , the UK and Canada , where it became his first number-one single as the lead artist .	One Dance	One Dance
This saw Drake leading the Billboard Hot 100 and the Billboard 200 simultaneously for eight weeks , coming close to a record held by Whitney Houston .	Whitney Houston	Whitney Houston
It achieved quadruple platinum status in the U.S. , and earned over 1 million album-equivalent units in the first week of its release .	platinum	Music recording sales certification

The single `` Hotline Bling '' secured him his second and third Grammy win , for Best Rap/Sung Performance and Best Rap Song , at the organization 's 59th ceremony .	Hotline Bling	Hotline Bling	Best Rap/Sung Performance	Best Rap/Sung Performance	Best Rap Song	Best Rap Song	59th ceremony	59th Annual Grammy Awards
Drake released the multi-genre More Life in 2017 .	genre	Music genre	More Life	More Life
Described by Drake as a playlist , it was his seventh consecutive number one on the Billboard 200 , and set multiple streaming records .	streaming	Streaming media
Drake owns several Billboard chart records .

He has the most charted songs -LRB- 154 -RRB- among solo artists in the history of the Billboard Hot 100 , the most simultaneously charted Hot 100 songs in a single week -LRB- 24 -RRB- , and the most Hot 100 debuts in a week -LRB- 21 -RRB- .
Drake also has the most number one singles on the Hot Rap Songs , Hot R&B / Hip-Hop Airplay and Rhythmic Charts .	R&B	Contemporary R&B	Hot Rap Songs	Hot Rap Songs	Rhythmic Charts	Rhythmic (chart)
Alongside his Grammy Award wins , Drake has won three Juno Awards and six American Music Awards .	Grammy Award	Grammy Award	Juno Awards	Juno Awards	American Music Awards	American Music Awards
Drake has developed other ventures , including his OVO Sound record label with longtime collaborator Noah `` 40 '' Shebib .	OVO Sound	OVO Sound	40	40 (record producer)
Drake acts as a producer , producing under the pseudonym of Champagne Papi .	producer	Hip hop production
Using the `` OVO '' moniker , Drake has his own clothing line and his own program on Beats 1 Radio .	Beats 1 Radio	Beats 1
